title: Puzzle2d Live Peer Sync
description: Restore commit-93 canvas speed while keeping commit-94 live cross-pane node-move/delete sync, by replacing per-frame full-scene WASM re-push on peer panes with lightweight incremental per-node position update in Rust/WASM BoardSession.
summary: Fixed pan/zoom/selection slowness on top of live peer drag sync: (1) descriptor-cache fast path now flushes pendingIncrementalNodeMoves via setNodePositionsJson; (2) markDirty only runs graph observation when observeGraph:true (scene mutations), selection/preselect/hover use invalidate() only; (3) skip paintTextOverlays during pan/wheel gestures; (4) incremental chrome updates only touch changed scene objects. 91 vitest tests pass.
